title: In a restaurant
source: User-provided workbook photo, manually transcribed; illustrated restaurant translations suggested separately

entries.example: Can I have a slice of your pizza?
entries.description: A thin, flat piece cut from bread, cake or pizza

entries.example: I want to be an actor, but I need the money.
entries.description: A person who plays a role in a film or on stage

entries.example: Here comes the main course.
entries.description: The biggest part of a meal, after the starter

entries.example: Let me pour it for you.
entries.description: To let a drink flow from a bottle into a glass

entries.example: One tomato soup for you and the onion soup for your husband.
entries.description: A hot liquid food you eat with a spoon

entries.example: The restaurant serves a delicious soup as a starter.
entries.description: The small dish you eat first in a restaurant

entries.example: I'll bring the soup straightaway.
entries.description: Immediately, right now

entries.example: The restaurant is completely dark.
entries.description: Totally, one hundred per cent

entries.example: A crane holds a large platform more than 50 m above the ground.
entries.description: A very tall machine that lifts heavy things on a building site

entries.example: You shouldn't drop your phone on the ground.
entries.description: To let something fall out of your hand

entries.example: The robots dance to entertain the guests.
entries.description: To make people have fun, for example with a show

entries.example: The waiter wears special glasses so that he can see in the dark.
entries.description: You wear these on your nose to see better

entries.example: There's a restaurant on a platform in the sky.
entries.description: A flat area that is higher than the ground around it

entries.example: The waiters serve the food.
entries.description: To bring food to people at the table

entries.example: There are several restaurants in my town.
entries.description: More than two but not very many

entries.example: Can I have the cabbage stew, please?
entries.description: A thick dish of meat and vegetables cooked slowly in liquid

entries.example: There's nothing in the fridge. Let's go to the supermarket.
entries.description: It keeps your food and drinks cold in the kitchen

entries.example: They complain about their food.
entries.description: To say that you are not happy with something

entries.example: A consumer is someone who buys something.
entries.description: A person who buys and uses things

entries.example: I'm waiting for my pizza delivery.
entries.description: When a shop brings the things you ordered to your home

entries.example: I downloaded the new Dua Lipa album.
entries.description: To copy music or a file from the internet onto your phone

entries.example: My phone stopped working. I want a refund.
entries.description: Money you get back from a shop when something is wrong

entries.example: Are you certain?
entries.description: Sure, without any doubt

entries.example: I changed my mind. I want pizza after all.
entries.description: To decide something different from before

entries.example: Leo goes to the gym.
entries.description: A place where you do sport or exercise

entries.example: Hurry up, I don't want to miss the bus.
entries.description: To be too late for the bus or train
